purpose: No prior getter: first pending SEND refreshes the closed-child link, then observe normal ignored-argument, current-result and selected-receiver cleanup.
source:
<?php
class UnusedDetachedSendCache41 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; } }
class UnusedDetachedSendReturn41 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
class UnusedDetachedSendArgument41 { function __destruct() { echo "ARG|"; unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["upper"], $GLOBALS["middle"], $GLOBALS["child"]); echo "ARG-END|"; } }
function unusedDetachedSendChild41() { echo "C|"; yield new UnusedDetachedSendCache41(); echo "L|"; return [new UnusedDetachedSendReturn41()]; }
function unusedDetachedSendMiddle41() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function unusedDetachedSendUpper41() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function unusedDetachedSendOuter41() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = unusedDetachedSendChild41(); $middle = unusedDetachedSendMiddle41(); $upper = unusedDetachedSendUpper41(); $outer = unusedDetachedSendOuter41();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); unset($child); echo "H|";
echo "S|";
$upper->send(new UnusedDetachedSendArgument41()); echo "CALLER|"; unset($copy); echo "DROPPED|"; echo "E";
